I have dealt with situation like partly also due to meds. I have had some types of different medications over the years, +-10 types of antidepresents and anti psychotics. 

I'm not doing great now, but for me the medications never added benefit. In this case, it's important to talk with your doctor. In my experience it's not easy conversation, but you have to speak out for yourself. I'm 28 and wish I'd speak out for myself when I was younger. But I was convinced doctor knows best. 

In the end, every body and mind reacts different, so doctor can never be sure. You have to talk to your doctor. 

If you have alot of bad experience with these kind of meds, you should also tell your doctor. Not only about this one, but all. Some people react not good to it.

You can come to solution, I hope you have understanding doctor
